$comment: Legends design tokens: the single source for Tailwind (web/) and Flutter ThemeData (mobile/). Values come from the design system board (legends-ui/Main.dc.html), and since X32 (2026-10-25) Legends' own signature after the owner asked for colours of our own: night ink (bg, panel), emerald (brand) for bands, table heads and the current section, gold for the calls to action and the coach's row, mint rings (ring) and ivory tabs (chrome) instead of the management games' blue and silver. Change here first, then regenerate both.

font.$license: Amin (Mostafa Amin, 2015; the owner's choice, Sprint 20 S2): the owner's files, served from web/public/fonts (woff2) and bundled in the apps; its embedding flag allows it. Barlow Condensed: SIL Open Font License, from Google Fonts, for the scores and counters.

match.$homeSide: RTL: the home team sits on the right of the score bug, so the score string reads away-home left to right.
